title: Quiet Protocol
style: downtempo electronic, trip-hop drums, deep sub bass, smoky female vocal, Rhodes piano, vinyl crackle, 88 bpm, late-night, neo-noir
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
We agreed without saying it out loud
A handshake between two quiet hands
No fine print, no signature, no crowd
Just a current we both understand

[Pre-Chorus]
Some things don't need contracts
Some things just need air

[Chorus]
Quiet protocol, soft as snow
Nobody knows but the people who know
Quiet protocol, sealed in the dark
A promise that hums without a spark

[Verse 2]
I sent you a sentence in a song
You sent me a silence in a kiss
We're writing a language that won't go wrong
In the only alphabet that's this

[Chorus]
Quiet protocol, soft as snow
Nobody knows but the people who know
Quiet protocol, sealed in the dark
A promise that hums without a spark

[Bridge]
No broadcast, no headline, no flag
Just the way you look up when I look up
No broadcast, no headline, no flag
Just the steady, the steady, the steady

[Outro]
Quiet, quiet, quiet protocol
Quiet, quiet, hold
